edits.after: An organization entitled to ask people to take on a role also takes on responsibilities of its own. It must pay the agreed compensation, provide the information, time, and resources needed to do the work, explain its rules and evaluation standards, protect people's safety and time for rest, and give them a way to ask questions, flag risks, and receive a response if they are treated improperly.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural phrase 'safeguard necessary safety' and clarify reciprocal duties without changing their scope.
edits.before: An organization entitled to ask its members to fulfill roles also assumes its own share of responsibility. It must pay the agreed compensation, provide the information, time, and resources needed to do the work, explain its rules and evaluation standards, safeguard necessary safety and rest, and enable people to raise questions, explain risks, and receive a response when they are treated improperly.

edits.after: Now the person is entrusting something more to the organization.
edits.reason: Make deeper entrustment natural in English while distinguishing it from the trust introduced earlier; the preceding paragraph retains all future-development examples.
edits.before: This is a deeper act of entrusting oneself.

edits.after: At this point, meaning is not deepening the relationship. It is helping the organization lay claim to things that were never handed over.
edits.reason: 'Reclaim' implies prior ownership; 'lay claim to' preserves the argument that these things were never ceded.
edits.before: At this point, meaning is not deepening the relationship. It is helping the organization reclaim things that were never handed over.

edits.after: Such work may be safe and follow all the rules, yet still feel hollow.
edits.reason: Replace the stiff 'yet proper and hollow' while retaining the distinction between safeguards and meaningful cooperation.
edits.before: Such work may be safe, yet proper and hollow.

edits.after: What they have not handed over is their body, dignity, overall worth, or right to keep deciding what place work should occupy in their life.
edits.reason: Replace abstract 'standing to keep deciding' with natural prose; preserve every excluded element.
edits.before: What is not handed over with it is their body, dignity, overall worth, and standing to keep deciding what place work should occupy in their life.

edits.after: A workplace worth belonging to does not first ask people to prove how much they are willing to lose.
edits.reason: Make the closing sentence idiomatic without weakening the normative 'worthy of belonging' distinction.
edits.before: Work truly worthy of belonging will not first demand that people prove how much they are willing to lose.

edits.after: Algunas personas acaban encontrando también en su trabajo un sentido de pertenencia.
edits.reason: 'Pertenecen a su trabajo' can suggest that the work owns them; clarify the intended sense of belonging.
edits.before: Algunas personas acaban sintiendo también que pertenecen a su trabajo.

edits.after: Un trabajo verdaderamente sano no trata esa confianza como un recurso del que se puede extraer sin cesar. Entiende que alguien entrega más posibilidades a un proyecto común precisamente porque sabe que puede reservarse algo, modificar su compromiso y, cuando sea necesario, retirarlo.
edits.reason: Clarify that it is the commitment one can revise or withdraw, rather than treating future possibilities themselves as objects to modify.
edits.before: Un trabajo verdaderamente sano no trata esa confianza como un recurso del que se puede extraer sin cesar. Entiende que alguien entrega más posibilidades a un proyecto común precisamente porque sabe que puede reservarlas, modificarlas y, cuando sea necesario, retirarlas.

edits.after: They first demand that members believe in the shared goal, then use that belief to explain why wages can temporarily be lower, hours can keep extending, procedures can be set aside for now, and people's health can take a little more strain. Anyone who sets a boundary is asked: do you really care about this?
edits.reason: 'Health can hold out' is an unnatural literal rendering. Retain the whole four-part rationalization and boundary question.
edits.before: They first demand that members believe in the shared goal, then use that belief to explain why wages can temporarily be lower, hours can keep extending, procedures can be set aside for now, and health can hold out a little longer. Anyone who sets a boundary is asked: do you really care about this?

edits.after: No amount of corporate messaging can bypass this sequence.
edits.reason: Render the sequence-versus-publicity point in readable English rather than the abstract 'an order that publicity cannot bypass'.
edits.before: This is an order that publicity cannot bypass.

edits.after: People need shared rules they can rely on before they are willing to trust. They need to know they will not be discarded for being vulnerable before they are willing to take risks. And they need to be able to participate without giving themselves up before they can truly feel they belong.
edits.reason: Preserve all three prior conditions and consequences while removing the repeated calque 'must come first before' and opaque 'basic standing'.
edits.before: Trustworthy shared rules must come first before people may be willing to trust; a basic standing that is not lost through vulnerability must come first before people may be willing to take risks; participation without the loss of self must come first before people may genuinely develop a sense of belonging.

edits.after: A job can therefore invite people to believe in what it does, strive to become a place worthy of their trust, and, through sustained practice, become a place where members genuinely feel they belong.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'earn sincere belonging' with its ordinary-reader meaning, preserving invitation, worthiness and long practice.
edits.before: A job can therefore invite people to believe, strive to become a place worthy of their trust, and earn sincere belonging through sustained practice.

edits.after: Una organización puede pagar puntualmente, cumplir rigurosamente las reglas y no humillar nunca en público a sus miembros, y aun así hacer que cada cual se limite a cumplir lo que le permite quedar a salvo de reproches. Nadie quiere proponer ideas inmaduras, asumir responsabilidades difíciles de cuantificar ni hacer un esfuerzo adicional cuando otro tiene dificultades.
edits.reason: The source concerns defensive work to avoid blame, not shirking accepted responsibilities as 'eludir responsabilidades' can imply.
edits.before: Una organización puede pagar puntualmente, cumplir rigurosamente las reglas y no humillar nunca en público a sus miembros, y aun así hacer que cada cual se limite a lo necesario para eludir responsabilidades. Nadie quiere proponer ideas inmaduras, asumir responsabilidades difíciles de cuantificar ni hacer un esfuerzo adicional cuando otro tiene dificultades.

edits.after: Las reglas pueden impedir ciertos daños, pero no crear por sí solas confianza. La remuneración puede comprar el trabajo acordado, pero no la disposición de las personas a confiar a la organización una parte de su futuro. Los lemas de la pared pueden explicar qué quiere ser la organización, pero no hacer que sus miembros conviertan realmente esa dirección en la suya.
edits.reason: Replace the awkward incomplete construction 'lo que las personas confían de su futuro'; retain all three rules/pay/slogans distinctions.
edits.before: Las reglas pueden impedir ciertos daños, pero no crear por sí solas confianza. La remuneración puede comprar el trabajo acordado, pero no lo que las personas confían de su futuro. Los lemas de la pared pueden explicar qué quiere ser la organización, pero no hacer que sus miembros conviertan realmente esa dirección en la suya.

edits.after: Debe respetar los límites de las personas incluso cuando el objetivo importa, hacer que quienes deciden respondan por sus decisiones cuando los resultados son malos y reconocer las contribuciones pasadas cuando alguien quiere irse. No puede hablar de organización solo cuando necesita que sus miembros se impliquen y refugiarse en que esto es solo un trabajo cuando sus miembros necesitan garantías, formación y respuestas.
edits.reason: The source says contributions/commitment, not that every requested contribution is necessarily a sacrifice. Retain the full reciprocal obligation argument.
edits.before: Debe respetar los límites de las personas incluso cuando el objetivo importa, hacer que quienes deciden respondan por sus decisiones cuando los resultados son malos y reconocer las contribuciones pasadas cuando alguien quiere irse. No puede hablar de organización solo cuando necesita sacrificios y refugiarse en que esto es solo un trabajo cuando sus miembros necesitan garantías, formación y respuestas.

edits.after: It is whether that availability has been spelled out: what its limits are, what arrangements support it, and when it ends.
edits.reason: Make the three scope/support/ending questions idiomatic while preserving them all.
edits.before: It is whether that availability has been clearly explained, has limits and corresponding arrangements, and has a point at which it ends.

edits.after: No one says you must reply, but if you do not, you miss information; no one says you must work during rest periods, but those who respond fastest are praised as committed; no one openly penalizes being offline, yet important opportunities always go to those who remain online.
edits.reason: Remove the ambiguous 'those who do not miss information', which can be parsed as people who do not miss information rather than nonresponders missing it.
edits.before: No one says you must reply, but those who do not miss information; no one says you must work during rest periods, but those who respond fastest are praised as committed; no one openly penalizes being offline, yet important opportunities always go to those who remain online.

edits.after: It means the organization is treating people's bodies as extra capacity it can stretch without limit.
edits.reason: Naturalize the institutional-capacity metaphor without removing the unlimited-extension critique.
edits.before: It means the organization is treating people's bodies as endlessly expandable room for its own arrangements.

edits.after: Good arrangements do not eliminate demands. They make the demands clear.
edits.reason: Replace the literal 'visible demands' with the practical meaning developed by the following paragraph.
edits.before: Good arrangements do not mean no demands. They mean visible demands.

edits.after: La cuestión es si esa disponibilidad está claramente definida, tiene límites, se acompaña de las medidas correspondientes y termina en algún momento.
edits.reason: 'Una organización correspondiente' is a calque; the source means supporting arrangements, not another organization.
edits.before: Es si esa disponibilidad está claramente definida, tiene límites y una organización correspondiente, y también si termina en algún momento.

edits.after: Más sutil todavía: a menudo ni siquiera hace falta una orden directa.
edits.reason: 'Lo más discreto' means discreet rather than the less visible mechanism intended here.
edits.before: Lo más discreto es que a menudo no necesita una orden directa.

edits.after: Al contrario, hace más probable que alguien quiera ayudar cuando realmente hace falta. Sabe que la organización no convertirá un gesto de confianza en el derecho a disponer indefinidamente de su tiempo ni interpretará su buena voluntad como una obligación ya vendida.
edits.reason: Make long-term appropriation of time explicit instead of the ambiguous 'una ocupación permanente'; preserve goodwill versus sold obligation.
edits.before: Al contrario, hace más probable que alguien quiera ayudar cuando realmente hace falta. Sabe que la organización no convertirá un gesto de confianza en una ocupación permanente ni interpretará su buena voluntad como una obligación ya vendida.

edits.after: The problem is that “professionalism” sometimes quietly stops being a standard for conduct and becomes a way of shutting down people's own judgment.
edits.reason: Replace the abstract 'cancellation of judgment' with natural prose while preserving conduct versus independent judgment.
edits.before: The problem is that “professionalism” sometimes quietly shifts from a requirement concerning behavior to the cancellation of judgment.

edits.after: A truly reliable person is not someone who never disagrees, but someone who knows how to bring disagreement into shared work. They can distinguish personal preferences from issues that affect results, turn dissatisfaction into reasons that can be examined, and, when the decision ultimately remains unchanged, make clear where they still disagree while conscientiously completing their own part.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'explain which judgments they retain' without changing the duty to carry out one's part despite retained objections.
edits.before: A truly reliable person is not someone who never disagrees, but someone who knows how to bring disagreement into shared work. They can distinguish personal preferences from issues that affect results, turn dissatisfaction into reasons that can be examined, and, when the decision ultimately remains unchanged, explain which judgments they retain while conscientiously completing their own part.

edits.after: It should make them better able to accomplish things with others without giving up who they are.
edits.reason: Avoid the mathematical-sounding 'canceling themselves out'; preserve cooperation without self-erasure.
edits.before: It should make them better able to accomplish things with others without canceling themselves out.

edits.after: El problema es que, a veces, la profesionalidad pasa silenciosamente de exigir una conducta a anular el criterio propio.
edits.reason: 'Cancelar el juicio' can sound like cancelling legal proceedings; use the independent-judgment language of the title and essay.
edits.before: El problema es que, a veces, la profesionalidad pasa silenciosamente de exigir una conducta a cancelar el juicio.

edits.after: Permite decir: «Ahora mismo no estoy en condiciones de dar lo mejor de mí en esta tarea». También permite reconocer errores, pedir ayuda y revisar el juicio. Reconocerlo no descalifica automáticamente a la persona: forma parte de un ajuste compartido.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'hacer esto en mi mejor estado' with an idiomatic statement of current limits.
edits.before: Permite decir: «Ahora no puedo hacer esto en mi mejor estado». También permite reconocer errores, pedir ayuda y revisar el juicio. Reconocerlo no descalifica automáticamente a la persona: forma parte de un ajuste compartido.

edits.after: Busca que juicios distintos puedan encontrarse dentro de un orden común, abordarse y convertirse finalmente en acciones coordinadas.
edits.reason: Use natural essay language rather than bureaucratic 'tramitarse'; preserve encounter, addressing differences and coordinated action.
edits.before: Busca que juicios distintos puedan encontrarse dentro de un orden común, tramitarse y convertirse finalmente en acciones coordinables.

edits.after: A role gives you more than income. It gives you a steady stream of responses from other people.
edits.reason: Make the continuing social-response point readable; the next paragraph retains requests, thanks, resources and promotion examples.
edits.before: A position gives a person not only income, but a continuing set of responses.

edits.after: People no longer ask which decision is better, but first ask what will preserve their position; they stop wanting to train potential successors, because being replaced feels like being erased; they stop acknowledging the limits of their abilities, as though having fewer responsibilities meant mattering less as a person.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'having less value in existence'; preserve all three defensive responses and their reasons.
edits.before: People no longer ask which decision is better, but first ask what will preserve their position; they stop wanting to train potential successors, because being replaced feels like being erased; they stop acknowledging the limits of their abilities, because having fewer responsibilities feels like having less value in existence.

edits.after: Good training and development should help people acquire that ability, too.
edits.reason: Clarify the workplace-development sense rather than the opaque standalone 'Good development'.
edits.before: Good development should also help this ability take shape.

edits.after: It need not become, “Without this, I will no longer be someone who counts.”
edits.reason: Make the recognition/value metaphor natural rather than the literal 'someone worth seeing'.
edits.before: It need not become, “Without this, I am no longer someone worth seeing.”

edits.after: A truly secure working relationship does not require people to weld their role to their identity.
edits.reason: Preserve the source's welding metaphor without the unnatural 'positions to their selves'.
edits.before: A truly secure working relationship does not require members to weld their positions to their selves.

edits.after: Al contrario: el puesto le dio mucho sentido, mientras otras partes de su vida no se desarrollaron del mismo modo durante mucho tiempo.
edits.reason: Do not strengthen the source's contrast into the claim that the job necessarily prevented other parts of life from developing.
edits.before: Al contrario: ha proporcionado tanto sentido que otras partes de la vida no han podido desplegarse del mismo modo durante mucho tiempo.

edits.after: No necesita transformarse además en: «Si lo dejo, ya no seré alguien que cuente».
edits.reason: Make the recognition/value metaphor natural in Spanish rather than treating it as literal visibility.
edits.before: No necesita transformarse además en: «Si lo dejo, ya no seré alguien que merezca ser visto».

edits.after: El puesto es un lugar que alguien ocupó y desde el que actuó.
edits.reason: Repair the unnatural 'desde el que alguien estuvo' while retaining the position-and-action image.
edits.before: El puesto es un lugar desde el que alguien estuvo y actuó.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work01–05 in bounded untruncated outputs, with titles; helper independently verifies paragraph text occurs in the archive Markdown and alignment. Total693 body-paragraph readings.
review_scope.semantic_review: Full argument/example/qualification comparison, not merely paragraph counts. Incoming EN/ES contain complete full-length arguments, not the old abbreviated English. Proposed changes retain every paragraph and argument; local repairs address awkward phrasing, ownership implications, recognition language and ambiguity. No source-level change found necessary.
review_scope.metadata: Five English titles remove numeric prefixes and are naturalized; two Spanish titles polished. The remaining Spanish titles are already natural and have no numeric prefix.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial/fidelity review, not independent legal, medical or empirical factchecking. No external factual claims added. No translation service. Did not execute supplied HTML scripts or edit ZIP/repo, commit, integrate or publish.
